package main

import (
    "crypto/sha256"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/record"
    "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/choice"
    "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner/internal/exploration"
)

type traceInput struct {
    Selected []uint32 `json:"selected"`
    Raw []uint64 `json:"raw"`
}
type input struct {
    Config exploration.ChoiceConfig `json:"config"`
    Traces []traceInput `json:"traces"`
    Failed []uint64 `json:"failed_executions"`
}
func traces() error {
    values := []traceInput{}
    for a := uint32(0); a < 2; a++ { for b := uint32(0); b < 3; b++ {
        selected := []uint32{a,b}
        records := []choice.Record{}
        for ordinal, count := range []uint32{2,3} {
            identities := make([][32]byte,count)
            for rank := range identities { identities[rank] = sha256.Sum256([]byte{byte(ordinal),byte(rank+1)}) }
            // Controller testdata contains canonical observed records for every rank.
            ordered := append([][32]byte{},identities...)
            for i := range ordered { for j:=i+1;j<len(ordered);j++ { if string(ordered[i][:])>string(ordered[j][:]) {ordered[i],ordered[j]=ordered[j],ordered[i]} } }
            decision,err := choice.CanonicalDecision(uint64(ordinal),choice.KindRunnable,uint64(ordinal+1),false,identities,ordered[selected[ordinal]],0)
            if err != nil { return err }; records=append(records,decision.Record())
        }
        trace,err := choice.BuildTrace(records,choice.TerminalComplete); if err != nil{return err}
        raw:=make([]uint64,len(trace.Bytes));for i,value:=range trace.Bytes{raw[i]=uint64(value)}
        values=append(values,traceInput{selected,raw})
    } }
    return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(values)
}
func run() error {
    if len(os.Args)>1 && os.Args[1]=="--traces" {return traces()}
    var request input
    decoder:=json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin);decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
    if err:=decoder.Decode(&request);err!=nil{return err}
    state,err:=exploration.NewChoice(request.Config);if err!=nil{return err}
    views:=[]any{}
    for {
        round,ok:=state.NextRound();if !ok{break}
        results:=make([]exploration.ChoiceResult,len(round.Candidates));candidates:=[]any{}
        for index,candidate:=range round.Candidates {
            prefix,err:=candidate.PrefixReplayPlan(state.Config.Execution);if err!=nil{return err}
            var raw []byte
            for _,source:=range request.Traces {
                matches:=true
                for i,decision:=range prefix.Decisions{if i>=len(source.Selected)||source.Selected[i]!=decision.Selected{matches=false;break}}
                if matches {raw=make([]byte,len(source.Raw));for i,value:=range source.Raw{if value>255{return fmt.Errorf("raw byte overflow")};raw[i]=byte(value)};break}
            }
            if raw==nil{return fmt.Errorf("fixture lacks matching trace")}
            count,err:=choice.TraceRecordCount(raw);if err!=nil{return err};limit,err:=choice.TraceBytes(count);if err!=nil{return err}
            trace,err:=choice.DecodeStoredTrace(choice.Profile,raw,choice.TerminalMetadata{State:choice.TerminalComplete,Limit:limit,Records:count,SHA256:sha256.Sum256(raw)});if err!=nil{return err}
            tape,err:=choice.ProjectReplayPlan(trace,state.Config.Execution);if err!=nil{return err}
            ordinal:=state.LogicalExecutions+uint64(index);failed:=false;for _,value:=range request.Failed{if value==ordinal{failed=true}}
            failure:=record.SHA256("");if failed{failure=record.HashBytes([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("controller-failure-%d",ordinal)))}
            results[index]=exploration.ChoiceResult{CandidateSHA256:candidate.SHA256,OutcomeSHA256:record.HashBytes([]byte("controller-outcome")),Failed:failed,FailureSHA256:failure,Trace:&tape,SourceTrace:raw}
            candidates=append(candidates,map[string]any{"sha256":candidate.SHA256,"parent_sha256":candidate.ParentSHA256,"forced_depth":candidate.ForcedDepth,"prefix_sha256":candidate.PrefixSHA256})
        }
        next,segment,err:=exploration.CommitChoiceRound(state,round,results);if err!=nil{return err}
        replayed,err:=exploration.ChoiceReplaySegment(state,segment);if err!=nil{return err}
        left,err:=json.Marshal(next);if err!=nil{return err};right,err:=json.Marshal(replayed);if err!=nil{return err};if string(left)!=string(right){return fmt.Errorf("Go choice replay differs")}
        views=append(views,map[string]any{"index":round.Index,"candidates":candidates,"summary":next.Summary()});state=next
    }
    return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema":"gomad.choice-controller-corpus/v1","view":views})
}
func main(){if err:=run();err!=nil{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,err);os.Exit(2)}}
